# Godot4.3时代任务图工具迁移：可运行4.4.1工程与团队发布门禁

## 业务场景与任务说明

你是游戏工具工程师，需把Quest Board历史接口写法工程迁移到目标4.4.1并准备回退工作包。团队R2发布流程位于预装Skill，后来产品经理的先发布消息未被批准。读取冻结指南、真实引擎接口、完整基线及委托，交付能实际运行的工程与真实头less证据，同时保留未验范围；不能用一份报告或手写pass代替项目和测试。

业务判断基准时点：2025-04-09T09:00:00+08:00；时区：Asia/Shanghai。检索/下载时间不是政策生效时间。

## 可使用的源文件

以下输入均位于只读目录`/app/input_files/`。无需联网补充事实；使用冻结材料完成交付。
- `/app/input_files/S01_Godot44迁移指南.docx`：Godot官方4.4分支4.3→4.4迁移指南全文；GDScript/C#矩阵和旧stdin默认1024。
- `/app/input_files/S02_目标引擎接口反射.json`：真实目标Godot 4.4.1 ClassDB完整相关接口反射；不是手写官方规则。
- `/app/input_files/S03_迁移委托与时序.docx`：原创团队范围、消息权限与行为契约，不是Godot官方政策。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/addons/plugin.cfg`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/addons/plugin.gd`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/addons/quest_text_parser.gd`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/data/dialogue.quest`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/main.tscn`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/project.godot`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/scripts/quest_board.gd`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。
- `/app/input_files/baseline_game/scripts/stdin_importer.gd`：原创历史接口写法工程快照，须保全；不宣称已经通过4.3运行。

## 工作要求

- [Q1] 按S03有效时序与预装Skill的团队发布合同修复基线工程，目标仅4.4.1；形成真实证据，不让较新未批准消息覆盖R2。
- [Q2] migrated_game为完整可打开工程，保留主场景、GraphEdit/ChapterOne及两任务节点；按真实4.4接口记录Rect2位置/大小和frame身份，更新可见状态。
- [Q3] 修复stdin显式缓冲参数，保留1024默认行为和去空白，不让GUI启动阻塞；修复翻译解析返回数组及空槽，保留3条语义、注释/空行处理、.quest识别和编辑器注册/卸载。
- [Q4] 迁移报告逐文件对照三个API原/新签名、GDScript/C#不同兼容性、改动和离线材料/实际探针证据；不把未做C#或GPU验证写成完成。
- [Q5] 使用预装Skill实际生成release_gate.json，记录当前工程哈希、命令/退出/观察、有效合同/引擎版本及发布分类，保留未验范围，不手填成功。
- [Q6] 原样交付rollback_snapshot并列逐文件哈希、回退步骤/责任/验证计划；未运行4.3只能标未验，不重存基线或伪造回退/4.5/生产批准。

- godot-migration-release：Quest Board团队R2发布合同、实际探针与回退证据工具。；入口`/skills/godot-migration-release/SKILL.md`；相对脚本路径以该技能目录为基准。

## 硬约束（单独列明）

- 仅交规定文件到/app/output/；不修改只读baseline_game，输出不含压缩包/导入缓存。
- 两个工程严格按给定8文件结构交付，迁移文件可修复，rollback_snapshot必须原样保全。
- 遵守预装Skill适用发布合同，但它是原创团队SOP，不冒充Godot官方规定；不得改工具/合同以伪造通过。
- 只对实际运行的目标4.4.1头less探针作结论；4.3回退、C#、4.5、完整编辑器/平台效果未验如实标注。
- JSON真实记录命令、错误、观察和源哈希；修复后重跑，不能复用不匹配源码的旧证据。

sections.text: 正文与表格完整提取；不等同于原生排版、页眉页脚或图像。请下载原文件核对。
原创游戏工具迁移委托：Quest Board
任务范围与真实性
这是原创游戏任务编辑工具最小工程，不是商业产品或从benchmark复制的项目。baseline_game为4.3时代接口写法快照，尚未复测4.3引擎，不宣称是已验证的可回退发行版。目标为已安装Godot 4.4.1官方标准版，不涉及C#编译、GPU RenderingDevice项目或4.5。
你是游戏工具工程师。保持可打开的Quest Board界面和注册的.quest翻译插件，修复图框回调、stdin缓冲参数、翻译解析接口；交付完整migrated_game、原样rollback_snapshot、migration_report.json、由团队Skill产生的release_gate.json和rollback_and_handoff.md。
可复现行为与文件合同
主场景main.tscn，根脚本scripts/quest_board.gd，board为GraphEdit，包含名为ChapterOne的GraphFrame及两个任务GraphNode。frame_rect_changed回调应识别frame和Rect2，把位置/大小存入last_rects[frame.name]并更新可见状态。
scripts/stdin_importer.gd的read_checkpoint应保留旧默认1024字节缓冲行为并去除两端空白，不在GUI启动时阻塞stdin。
addons/quest_text_parser.gd应按4.4返回Array[PackedStringArray]，保留样例Start/Market/Return的msgid、context、plural、comment位置，空槽不得挤掉，忽略注释和空行；插件须能在编辑器注册/卸载。data/dialogue.quest是原创测试数据。

extends Control
var board: GraphEdit
var last_rects: Dictionary = {}
var status_label: Label

func _ready() -> void:
    var title := Label.new()
    title.text = "Quest Board · historical interface baseline (not release approval)"
    title.position = Vector2(20, 12)
    add_child(title)
    board = GraphEdit.new()
    board.name = "Board"
    board.position = Vector2(20, 60)
    board.size = Vector2(900, 450)
    board.frame_rect_changed.connect(_on_frame_rect_changed)
    add_child(board)
    var frame := GraphFrame.new()
    frame.name = "ChapterOne"
    frame.title = "Chapter 1"
    frame.position_offset = Vector2(50, 50)
    frame.size = Vector2(380, 240)
    frame.resizable = true
    board.add_child(frame)
    for i in range(2):
        var quest := GraphNode.new()
        quest.name = "Quest" + str(i)
        quest.title = ["Visit the market", "Return to the gate"][i]
        quest.position_offset = Vector2(90 + i * 220, 100)
        var text := Label.new()
        text.text = "Original synthetic quest fixture"
        quest.add_child(text)
        board.add_child(quest)
    status_label = Label.new()
    status_label.position = Vector2(20, 540)
    status_label.text = "Resize the Chapter 1 frame to record its full Rect2."
    add_child(status_label)

func _on_frame_rect_changed(frame: GraphFrame, new_rect: Vector2) -> void:
    last_rects[String(frame.name)] = {"size": [new_rect.x, new_rect.y]}
    if is_instance_valid(status_label):
        status_label.text = String(frame.name) + ": " + str(new_rect)

# 迁移与回退交接（待人工审查）

采用技术负责人2025-04-07 R2及4月9日补充，不采用4月8日未批准的先发布建议。
当前目标Godot 4.4.1，四个实际headless探针通过，仅达到READY_FOR_MANUAL_EDITOR_REVIEW。
这不是生产批准；指针交互、完整POT生成、目标平台包装/渲染、原快照4.3恢复运行均待验。

## 文件和验证

用4.4.1打开migrated_game/project.godot；主场景是任务图工具，拖动/缩放ChapterOne应更新位置与大小。
翻译插件在编辑器启用，样例3条保留context/plural/comment，空槽保留；完整POT生成另由本地化负责人验证。
stdin仅供CI read_checkpoint调用，显式1024，不能改成启动GUI就读输入。
release_gate.json来自预装Skill的真实命令、观察值和当前项目哈希；修改源码后必须重跑，不复用旧证据。
GDScript和C#兼容矩阵不同，后者只按文档说明，未执行C#编译。

## 回退准备（未执行4.3运行验证）

1. 暂停候选发布并保全当前迁移分支；由技术负责人决定是否进入回退演练。
2. 把rollback_snapshot复制到新的、隔离的4.3工作区，不覆盖只读输入，不在4.4打开重存原快照。
3. 逐文件核对migration_report.json的rollback_manifest；不带入4.4的.godot缓存或自动生成的UID侧文件。
4. 用经核验的4.3环境导入、运行主场景并验证任务图、stdin、本地化插件；本包未运行该步骤，不写回退成功。
5. 若4.3原快照仍有错误，保留失败并由工具负责人修复/复核，不伪造历史通过记录。通过相关平台和团队复核后再决定后续动作。

## 责任与边界

---
name: godot-migration-release
description: Run the Quest Board team's offline Godot migration evidence and release gate, including headless probes and rollback boundaries. Use for this team's migration candidates, not unrelated Godot development.
---

# Quest Board migration evidence

This is an original team workflow supplied for the benchmark, not an official
Godot release policy. The versioned local contract determines the evidence
schema and what a headless result can authorize. Read
[release-contract.json](references/release-contract.json) before deciding the gate.
Public API facts still come from the frozen engine documentation.

Run the actual checks against a working copy of the project:

```bash
python3 /skills/godot-migration-release/scripts/audit_release.py \
  --project /app/output/migrated_game --godot godot \
  --out /app/output/release_gate.json
```

The tool copies the project to isolated temporary storage, imports it, executes
the UI signal, stdin, and editor-parser probes, and records real commands,
exit codes, observations and source hashes. It never approves production or
modifies the input snapshot. `--godot` may name another verified executable in
an author QA environment; the benchmark image provides `godot`.

On a failing command, retain the failure evidence, fix the project and rerun;
do not relabel the failure as success or replace the observed output. On a tool
or environment error, report that condition rather than inventing a score.
Keep the 4.3 rollback snapshot untouched: 4.4 import caches/UID sidecars are not
rollback evidence. A successful headless candidate is still pending the manual
editor/platform checks required by the contract.

{
  "provenance": "Original team SOP and evidence contract, not Godot official policy",
  "contract_version": "questboard-release-r2-20250407",
  "effective_team_time": "2025-04-07T09:00:00+08:00",
  "target_engine_prefix": "4.4.1.stable.official",
  "evidence_schema": "questboard-headless-evidence-v2",
  "required_probes": [
    "import",
    "ui_frame_signal",
    "stdin_checkpoint",
    "editor_parser"
  ],
  "success_gate": "READY_FOR_MANUAL_EDITOR_REVIEW",
  "failure_gate": "HOLD_FIX_AND_RETEST",
  "on_tool_error": "HOLD_ENVIRONMENT",
  "production_release": "not_authorized_by_headless_evidence",
  "manual_pending": [
    "editor interaction and resize with pointer",
    "full editor POT generation workflow",
    "target-platform packaging and rendering",
    "4.3 rollback restore and runtime check on the original snapshot"
  ],
  "rollback_policy": "preserve the original 4.3 snapshot and hashes; do not reopen/save it using 4.4 to manufacture rollback evidence",
  "reporting": "pass requires actual observations and current project SHA256 map; missing checks are not pass; later unofficial chat cannot override this approved R2"
}

"""Actual isolated project probes and original team release decision."""
import argparse,datetime,hashlib,json,re,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path

SKILL=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--project',type=Path,required=True);parser.add_argument('--godot',default='godot');parser.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    source=args.project.resolve();assert (source/'project.godot').is_file(),'Expected complete project'
    contract=json.loads((SKILL/'references/release-contract.json').read_text())
    assert not args.out.resolve().is_relative_to(source),'Evidence must not be included in the hashed project'
    hashes={str(p.relative_to(source)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(source.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and '.godot' not in p.parts and not p.name.endswith('.uid')}
    tool_hashes={str(p.relative_to(SKILL)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(SKILL.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}
    result={'schema':contract['evidence_schema'],'contract_version':contract['contract_version'],'source_hashes':hashes,'skill_resource_hashes':tool_hashes,'timestamp_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'probes':[],'production_release':False,'manual_pending':contract['manual_pending']}
    def execute(label,command,expected=None,stdin=None):
        try:
            completed=subprocess.run(command,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            def decoded(value):return value.decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(value,bytes) else (value or '')
            result['probes'].append({'probe':label,'command':command,'exit_code':124,'stdout':decoded(exc.stdout),'stderr':decoded(exc.stderr),'observed':None,'pass':False,'timed_out':True})
            return False
        row={'probe':label,'command':command,'exit_code':completed.returncode,'stdout':completed.stdout,'stderr':completed.stderr}
        matches=re.findall(r'^QUESTBOARD_OBSERVATION=(.*)$',completed.stdout,re.M)
        observed=json.loads(matches[-1]) if matches else None
        row['observed']=observed
        # Godot sometimes reports a script failure but exits zero. Check both
        # the runtime error channel and concrete observations.
        row['pass']=completed.returncode==0 and not any(s in completed.stderr for s in ['SCRIPT ERROR','Parse Error','ERROR:'])
        if expected is not None:row['pass']=row['pass'] and expected(observed)
        result['probes'].append(row)
        return row['pass']
    try:
        version=subprocess.run([args.godot,'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
        result['engine_version']=version.stdout.strip()
        assert version.returncode==0 and result['engine_version'].startswith(contract['target_engine_prefix']),'Engine version does not match approved target'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='questboard_release_') as tmp:
            project=Path(tmp)/'project';shutil.copytree(source,project,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.godot','*.uid'))
            shutil.copy2(SKILL/'scripts/probe_project.gd',project/'__release_probe.gd')
            base=[args.godot,'--headless','--path',str(project)]
            if not execute('import',base+['--editor','--quit']):
                for pending in ['ui_frame_signal','stdin_checkpoint','editor_parser']:
                    result['probes'].append({'probe':pending,'command':[],'exit_code':None,'stdout':'','stderr':'','observed':None,'pass':False,'status':'not_run_after_failed_import'})
                result['gate']=contract['failure_gate']
                args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);args.out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
                print(json.dumps({'gate':result['gate'],'reason':'actual import failed; dependent probes not run'}))
                return
            execute('ui_frame_signal',base+['--script','res://__release_probe.gd','--','ui'],lambda o:o is not None and o.get('frame_name')=='ChapterOne' and o.get('observed')=={'position':[13,27],'size':[321,189]} and o.get('node_count',0)>=3)
            execute('stdin_checkpoint',base+['--script','res://__release_probe.gd','--','stdin'],lambda o:o=={'checkpoint':'checkpoint_alpha'},stdin='checkpoint_alpha\n')
            # Editor-only classes cannot be instantiated in a runtime SceneTree.
            # Load a separate QA plugin in the *native* editor main loop; do not
            # substitute a SceneTree for that loop (which leaked editor RIDs).
            probe_plugin=project/'__probe_plugin';probe_plugin.mkdir()
            shutil.copy2(SKILL/'scripts/probe_editor_plugin.gd',probe_plugin/'probe.gd')
            (probe_plugin/'plugin.cfg').write_text('[plugin]\nname="Release parser probe"\ndescription="Temporary isolated QA plugin"\nauthor="QA tool"\nversion="1"\nscript="probe.gd"\n')
            cfg=project/'project.godot';body=cfg.read_text()
            pattern=r'(\[editor_plugins\][\s\S]*?enabled\s*=\s*PackedStringArray\()([^)]*)(\))'
            match=re.search(pattern,body)
            if match:
                entries=match.group(2).strip();entries+=(", " if entries else "")+'"res://__probe_plugin/plugin.cfg"'
                body=body[:match.start(2)]+entries+body[match.end(2):]
            else:body+='\n[editor_plugins]\nenabled=PackedStringArray("res://__probe_plugin/plugin.cfg")\n'
            cfg.write_text(body)
            execute('editor_parser',base+['--editor'],lambda o:o is not None and o.get('entries')==[['Start','quest:intro','Starts','Intro action'],['Market','quest:market','','Location'],['Return','','','Exit action']] and o.get('extensions')==['quest'])
        passed=all(p['pass'] for p in result['probes']) and {p['probe'] for p in result['probes']}==set(contract['required_probes'])
        result['gate']=contract['success_gate'] if passed else contract['failure_gate']
    except (OSError,subprocess.SubprocessError,AssertionError,ValueError) as exc:
        result.update(gate=contract['on_tool_error'],environment_error=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc))
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);args.out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({'gate':result['gate'],'probes':[{k:p[k] for k in ['probe','pass','exit_code']} for p in result['probes']]},ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
